[h1][b]Added new mode "Tactical Shooter"[/b][/h1]

[h3][b]Mode Guide[/b][/h3]
▶ Based on the explosion mode, you can acquire points in various battle situations and purchase weapons each round to proceed with battles.
▶ The matches range from 2vs2 to 5vs5, and interference is also allowed.
▶ In the first round, you will be given basic equipment such as a pistol, knife, and 800P.
▶ You can purchase weapons with the 800P you received.
▶ Each round has a preparation phase where you can purchase weapons with points.
▶ You can keep the weapons you purchase until you die, after which only the basic pistol and knife will remain.
** Equipment acquired during battle will be retained even if not purchased.
▶ When the teams are switched, all equipment will disappear and you will be given basic equipment and 800P just like in the first round.

[h2][b]Additional Details:[/b][/h2]

[h3][b]I. System Overview[/b][/h3]

1. Planning Intention
- This plan is based on the annihilation mode in most modes, and aims to strategically operate guns by purchasing them using the points that users normally earn in the game based on the explosion mode.

2. Goal
- A new mode that is more meaningful as a team battle
→ The new mode, which focuses on annihilation mode, is based on the explosion mode and is more focused on individual battles that rely on physical strength rather than strategic team battles.

- Utilization of information (points) with low usability in the game
→ Earn points from kills/assists in the game battle screen and use them to purchase weapons using the advancement points from that battle.
- No protective gear or presets available when starting the game
→ You cannot use presets and must purchase equipment using points. You can also purchase and use protective gear.

[h3][b]II. Mode Method[/b][/h3]
1. Winning Rules
- (Common) Kill all members of the opposing team.

(Exception) (Defense Team) Attacking Tingim C4 can only be installed before winning under this condition.
→ After installation, the installed C4 must be dismantled even if the attacking team is annihilated.

(Simultaneous Annihilation) C4 (not) installed (Common) If both teams are annihilated simultaneously due to grenade exposure, etc., the winner is determined by whether or not C4 is installed.

→ When not installed, the defending team wins, and when installed, the attacking team wins.
- (Attack team) Successfully install C4 and win regardless of whether the attack team is annihilated or not when it activates.
- (Defense team) Successfully dismantled the C4 installed by the attacking team.
- (Defense team) Prevent the attacking team from installing C4 for a limited time.

2. Game Start Rules
- At the start of the game, the player starts with only the default pistol and the default knife.
- 800P is paid when [Game Start] or [Air-Defense Exchange] is performed.

3. Equipment preservation and deletion rules
- If the character survives by winning a round during the round, the equipment will be used in the next round (magazine-related changes to full settings)
→ When purchasing equipment items, delete items that share the preset line you are currently holding.
→ When purchasing equipment items, delete the items you are currently holding.                                            
- When obtaining dropped equipment, the item you were holding is dropped (same as existing rules)
→ When a round ends with dropped equipment, the item is kept, except in cases where the deletion rule applies in subsequent rounds.
- When you die in battle, your equipment will be deleted (except for the default pistol and knife).
→ Delete items that can be purchased from the store        
- When changing the airborne equipment, the equipment and store usage points are deleted (changed to the default equipment status).
→ To adjust the difficulty when changing the airborne.

4. Number of participants
- No level limit, unlike the basic blast mode, minimum number of players is 2vs2 ~ 5vs5 (interception possible)

5. Game usage time
- Changed to 2 minutes and 30 seconds per round, with 40 seconds remaining when C4 is installed    
- Provides a waiting time of 3 seconds when the first round is in progress (including the change of attack and defense).
→ After the first round ends, 15 seconds of purchase time is provided to purchase equipment.
A plan) Only the point store can be used during the waiting time
B plan) The store is available and you can move around during the waiting time, but you cannot leave the respawn area.

notes.title: October 26, 2023 Update Patch Notes
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28770675/1df298c79d39e26b7f846e9c90c5624f6eba0ad0.jpg[/img]

1.	News Popup Window Addition Announcement
▶ A new informational popup window will be available for checking events and new products after the October 26, 2023 maintenance.
▶ Check it anytime through the 'News' button above the Mission button.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28770675/6323104148e598f1b3c54b4845d811458b9d7e89.png[/img]

2.	Diamond Grade Background Change Notice
▶ After the maintenance on October 26, 2023, the Diamond grade background will be changed as follows.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28770675/64d1532ae47c2e8a7a74675d31cb1bc113c79979.png[/img]

3.	Character Random Box Change Notice
▶ After the maintenance on October 26, 2023, the sale of character random boxes purchasable with bullets will be discontinued.
▶ After the maintenance on October 26, 2023, 'ALL Character Random Box' and 'Target Character Random Box' will be available for purchase.
  ㆍ 'ALL Character Random Box' is a product that allows you to obtain characters from 'Bronze' to 'Platinum' grades, released until December 22nd of the current year.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28770675/ad0478c7f14a10fa2b0bc0214ad792d482dbd96a.png[/img]

4.	New Character and Costume Update
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28770675/5e7b49d1eb515d4ec86d0beffdffb4fcfa720b97.png[/img]

[Panda & Brown Bear]
▶ Sales of 'Carrier Random Box (Panda & Brown Bear)' will begin after maintenance on October 26, 2023.
  ㆍ Sales Period: October 26, 2023, 05:00 (UTC) ~ November 23, 2023, 05:00 (UTC).
  ㆍ This is a random box where you can obtain 'Panda & Brown Bear' characters of Bronze to Platinum grades.
  ㆍ The probability of acquiring permanent items is two times higher.
  ㆍ 'Panda & Brown Bear' characters can use a pass extension from the maintenance on January 24, 2024.
▶ New costume tuning options will be added for 'Panda & Brown Bear.'
  ㆍ The newly added costume tuning options are available for Gold to Diamond grade characters.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28770675/702331ecdb8e306f2cc469e340a779ef687798a4.png[/img]

[Panda & Brown Bear - Zombie]

▶ New costume modification options are added for the 'Code Name: Zero' character.
  ㆍ The newly added costume tuning options are available for Silver to Diamond grade characters.
  ㆍ The Diamond grade 'Code Name: Zero' can be obtained through combinations.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28770675/d4d8e884fe5e514dbf9c0b3e62fc5bf9845308ec.png[/img]

▶ AI BOT TDM training difficulty level has been added.
  ※ This is a practice mode with the same abilities as the AI before the September 7th patch.
  ※ Training mode does not allow you to earn '[Daily - Special] AI Points' mission points.
  ※ Can complete missions such as AI play missions and AI kill missions.
▶ A combination - special reward combination item list popup has been added.
  ※ This popup allows you to check items that can only be obtained through combinations.
  ※ You can summon the popup by pressing the button in the upper right corner.

▶ Notice Regarding Server Delays and Lag Related to Inventory and Storage
  ※ After the temporary maintenance on September 26, 2023, we have identified an issue where players experience lag when entering their inventory, making item changes, or receiving mail with random boxes included, especially when holding a certain amount of items.
  ※ Currently, we are actively investigating the root cause of this issue by examining all aspects related to the inventory and storage. We will make every effort to resolve this problem as quickly as possible.

1. Character Costume Update

▶ Before maintenance on June 22nd 2023, sales of ‘Character Random Box(Elena B)’ will be ended.
▶ After maintenance on June 22nd 2023, sales of ‘Character Random Box(Lin)’ will be started.
  - Sales Period : After maintenance on 06.22.2023 ~ before maintenance on 07.06.2023
  - Price : 225 Bullets/Steam 250 Bullets
  ∴ 'Lin (Gold)' appears in the box as a pickup character.
  ∴ Lin is most likely to come out of a box during the sales period. 
▶ New costume option of ‘Lin’ will be added.
  - New costume tuning options are available from Gold to Platinum Grade Character.
∴ Costume can be opened by consuming the same grade character.
∴ ex) Gold Grade Character x2 + TP(C) = Gold Grade Character Costume Open
▶ A new costume tuning option for 'Jayce' is added.
  - The new costume tuning options are available from 'Silver' to 'Platinum' grade character.
  ∴ Costume can be opened by consuming the same grade character.
∴ Ex) Gold Grade Character x2 + TP(C) = Gold Grade Character Costume Open
∴ The Platinum Character can consume TP(C) to obtain the corresponding costume.

notes.title: February 23 Update
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28770675/7561c6d3c252713eec906c0d5118369cea4f801c.jpg[/img]

1. Super Match Improvements
 ▶ Super Match Improvement
  - Existing: 20 minutes of sponsorship / Game start after the end of sponsorship 
- Change: 10 minutes of sponsorship / Game start 5 minutes after the start of sponsorship 
→ However, a 20% pre-fee will be applied to sponsors at the start of the game.
    → The ranking will be counted as the value that the pre-fee is excluded from the sponsorship ranking.
    → The donation will be entered as the value that the pre-fee is excluded from the record.
  - A new sponsorship method will be added.
     (1) Quinella: Two players selected regardless of the order will succeed if they win first and second place.
     (2) Triple Quinella: Three players selected regardless of the order will succeed if they win the first, second and third place.
  - ‘30 seconds’ delay for observing the super match has been applied.

2. Add a new character: Jessica

notes.title: January 19th, 2023 Update
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28770675/2be26f105183fdd08444c9cae17b84e93b42e8f6.jpg[/img]
January 19, 2023 Update 
Maintenance for the game service will be carried out on Thursday, January 19th.
For more information, please check the information below.

1. Added new Sponsorship method for Super Match: Place
 ▶ A Place will be added to the super match sponsorship.
     - Types of winning Place added: Place, Quinella Place
 ▶ What is ‘Place?
     - Sponsorship by selecting one person, and a reward will be paid if the user achieves the top 3 grade.
 ▶ What is ‘Quinella Place’?
      - Sponsorship by selecting 2 people, and a reward will be given if all the users achieve the top 3 results.

2. Super Match Map changes
	The maps below will no longer appear in Super Match.
<RUN AND GUN>, <SANTORINI>
	The following maps will additionally appear in Super Match.
<DUST SHIELD>, <CARRIER>, <CASTLE>, <TWO FACED>, <OLD TEMPLE>, <OUTPOST>, <RUST>

3. Add a new character: Owen

"A boy mercenary born in a war, a veteran infiltrator hiding his madness!"

 ▶After the maintenance on January 19, new agent Owen will participate in the Black Squad.
 ▶The Owen character tuning option will be added.
  - Added option to reduce dispatch completion time. The completion time of dispatch will be reduced by 1% to 10 %.
  - Added the option of increasing EXP. When the game is over, you will get an additional 5%-20% experience.
  - Added the option of increasing EXP. When the game is over, you will get an additional 20-50 experience.
 ▶ There will be Thank additional 4 accessory tuning options.
  - Added [Epaulette R] slot option. You can install the [Epaulette R] when you open it. 
  - Added [Epaulette L] slot option. You can install the [Epaulette L] when you open it.
  - [Necklace] Slot option added. You can create a [Necklace] when you open it.
  - [Bag] Slot option added. You can install the [Bag] when you open it.

notes.title: December 22nd 2022 Update
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28770675/e7a671aa274b7e26085b45cc0c34cb0d5b739b1b.jpg[/img]

December 22nd 2022 Update (Notice)


1. Competitive Match Season 17 Changes
▶ Depending on the result of the competition, Super Match Ranking Points can be obtained.
▶ Competitive Match will be changed from ‘Demolition - Class’ Mode to ‘Demolition mode.

2. Super Match Improvements
  ▶ Super Match Improvements
    - Super Match will be rescheduled.
     ·Previous: 7,8 minutes apart
     ·Change: 1 hour apart
- Super Match's mode will be limited to Demolition Mode
- Maps used to Super Match will be limited in 10 types as below.
     ·BROOKLYN, DOUBLE WING, RUN AND GUN, CHECKPOINT, SANTORINI, WOLF SPIDER, SABOTAGE, NIGHT TOWN, COLLECTION, PAPER COMPANY
- The number of Super Match's participants will be changed to be flexible from 8 to 6~10. 
    - Abolition of Minor Leases
     ·Super Match Minor League will be abolished.
     ·However, you can earn super match rank points by participating in the competition.
    - Add Other Super Match Features
     ·Sponsor ranking by Super Match will be added.
     ·The function of watching the ongoing Super Match game will be added.
       > If you are included in the 10th place in the sponsorship ranking for each competition, you can use the competition you sponsored.
       > The viewing function is available on the 'Game Status' screen for games in progress.

3. Add Character Tuning Options : Letty, Marie
▶ ‘The new accessories tuning option for the 'Marie' character is added.
    - Two additional accessory options have been added. 
     ·[Necklace] Slot option added. You can attach the [Necklace] when you open it.
     ·[Bag] Slot option added. [Bag] can be fitted when opened.

▶ The 'Marie' character's in-game bonus tuning option is added.
    - The option to reduce the completion time of the dispatch has been added. The completion time is reduced by 1% to 10% when dispatched.

▶ New costume tuning options for the 'Letty' character are added.
    - Two costume options have been added.
     ㆍCostume Option : ‘Christmas’ is added

notes.title: Changes for Ongoing Events related to Itaewon Crowd Crush
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28770675/44d74ff6bdb540b1ee849f0138dd8afe5243f58e.jpg[/img]
Changes for Ongoing Events related to Itaewon Crowd Crush

Hello.
This Black Squad Development and Operation team.

Last 29th October Saturday, a tragic crowd crush occurred in Itaewon, South Korea.
We pray for the victims of the Itaewon crowd crush and our deepest condolences to the bereaved families.

As announced the national mourning period until 5th November 24:00 A.M. (KST),
We are going to change the events related to Halloween events

[Event Changes]
Previous events will be changed to AUTUMN LEAVES, and part of the reward contents will be changed. You can continue to obtain the rewards if you didn’t achieve the event’s condition.
※ Event end date is the same as before maintenance on 17th November.
※ If you already obtained the reward random boxes without opening them, the contents will be changed to the same as the notice after the patch on 1st November.

We ask for your understanding of those who are currently playing in-game events.

We pray for the victims of the Itaewon crowd crash once again,
We are also praying for injured everyone’s quick recovery.

Thank you.

[h3]AUTUMN with a New Function[/h3]

[h2]Vote Kick[/h2]
Vote kick is added against an ally member benefiting the opponent team. Be aware it is not the function to kick opponent team players. Once the targeted player get kicked, the player cannot join the match again.

Only unanimous vote except the player-to-be-kicked result a kick. And some details here
[list][*]The vote of the player submitting the vote kick counts as a yes.
[*]If there is no feedback in 30 seconds, it will be counted as a no.
[*]A player's leave during a vote is counted as a yes.
[*]Players entering a match during vote cannot vote, nor count.[/list]

Here comes a new mode: SUPPLY RAID!
Revamped tactics with Weapon Rebalancing applied to all modes & Updated Flak Jackets.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28770675/0d59c29fc07ad06051a08b5ddf247e199edb0827.jpg[/img]

[h2]SUPPLY RAID[/h2]
Team mode with max 8 on 8
[list][*]A team making its team score to reach the designated point first wins.
[*]A player needs to play with limited number of ammunition.
[*]To raise score, there are mainly 2 ways: get opponents’ weapons, or get items from supply boxes to destroy,
[list][*]Getting items from supply boxes raise team score with ammos, without individual score increase.
[*]Obtaining weapons from enemies increases both individual and team score.
[*]An individual score is limited up to 400. But earned score is contributed to a team score still.
[*]When a player equips a pistol, 1 individual score is obtained every 3 seconds.
[*]When a player equips a SMG or a shotgun, 1 individual score is obtained every 6 seconds. After a player reaches the score to get a LMG, there is no auto score increase.
[*]Destroying a supply box itself does not raise any score.[/list]
[*]A weapon to equip is stepping up by the player’s score.
[list][*]Pistol → SMG, Shotgun → LMG → Assault Rifle[/list]
[*]A score to get is affected by the differences between the individual scores. E.g. when a player of higher individual score gets the weapon of the player lower individual score, the player will get smaller score increase.
[*]Just step on items from supply boxes or opponents’ weapons to get them.
[list][*]Max. bullets of 1 magazine can be supplemented when getting weapons or items.
[*]Getting a dropped weapon will not let the player’s weapon to switch.
[*]Weapons of the player of the same team cannot be obtained.[/list]
[*]Players are respawned at random locations including match start place.
[*]Supply boxes are generated at specific locations at maps.[/list]

notes.title: UPDATE 12: PATCH NOTE
notes.notes:
[h1]NEW MODE : ARMS RACE[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28770675/f7d27b5c9fc4145a3722c0a27bb6c77c7c381c4a.png[/img]
The latest mode arrives at Black Squad.
ARMS RACE provides the ladder to climb up from the equal footing. In the new mode, all joining players will follow the same, fixed weapon set, and challenge to reach the target score.
The weapon of each step will be changed by month. And if a condition is met, brand-new skin of the weapon is available at the match: first reach, first served.

The mode is added to Quick Match.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28770675/375dbf141af356d83a980464198811da0f1aa24c.png[/img]
[list]
[*] The goal of this 8v8 match is to reaches 40 kills by a player in a limited time.
[*] A designated kills will change your equipped weapon. 
[*] A player can equip only the fixed weapon by the designated order. The other weapons cannot be used nor swap to other primary/secondary/melee weapon or grenades. Also it is not possible to pick up a dropped weapon.
[*] If the score does not reach 40 and the time expires, the team of a higher weapon step wins.
[*] If the steps tie, the team of more total kills wins.
[*] When the win is not decided by the conditions above and the total kills of both team tie at the end of the match, an extra time is given. and there is a kill, the win is decided by 'sudden death/golden goal' rules -  the team of the kill wins.
[*] The match becomes a draw if there is no kill still and the extra time expires.
[*] The player reaching each step of a weapon first will use the latest skin version of the weapon in the match. 
[*] The score shows the most kills by a player of each team, not sum of kills.
[*] The next weapon and kill count to reach the weapon can be found under the score.
[*] When you reach the final step of the weapon, it will show the final goal.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28770675/1f91155fa5e9eb35afdd83c16b95b5c7d661bc56.png[/img]

Aiming the competitive and enjoyable playground, we are planning the improvements related to the competitive match - often called as 'ranked' - and clan match. We had discussions inside the team, and the coverage of the topics was wide. The period of the season, teaming-up, matchmaking, the tracking of the background of the introduction of the mode, how each mode is considered by players, and so on. We hope our discussion may bring better and more enjoyable playground to Black Squad users. As a small leap, we are planning regular clan events in the future, starting from the next week. You will find more changes to follow up, and we hope you enjoy.[/code]

[h1]WINTER EVENT 2019[/h1] WINTER EVENT 2019 begins.[/h1]
[list][*]Schedule
[list][*]Starts: December 4, 2019 right after the Steam update.[/list]
[*]Contents
[list][*]During the event period you can win WINTER POINTs from various missions. With WINTER POINTs, some items or random boxes are purchasable.[/list]
[*]WINTER POINTS
[list][*]Timed grenade / smoke / flashbang / spray, and HOLIDAY TREE EVENT BOX can be purchased with WINTER POINTs at the Medal Shop
[list][*]From HOLIDAY TREE EVENT BOX, one of timed characters among YUI, JUGGERNAUT COSTUME, CRAIG, BRIMOB / PASKHAS can be obtained at random.[/list]
[*]HOLIDAY TREE BOX 2019 can be opened with WINTER POINTs at the Random Box Shop.
[*][Note] WINTER POINTs will be removed when the WINTER EVENT 2019 ends.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28770675/a02ae3c3418f822ca011c27e95074edc89f4e88a.png[/img][/list]
[*]Attendance Check Rewards Up
[list][*]'HAPPY HOLIDAY +50% DOUBLE UP BOOSTER / 1D can be earned each day as a part of the attendance check rewards.[/list]
[*]Destruction 10v10 Mode ‘[EVENT] Cream Cake 10V10’ added to Quick Match Channel.
[list][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28770675/bc3d343f49b24977d6188edc8ed6ca418eaa5459.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28770675/7f31bcd6ed5b9c497f036441e9c08b321726350b.png[/img][/list]
[*]Quick Match channel will have [EVENT] Cream Cake 10v10 (Destruction Mode).
[list][*]Cream Cake 10v10 is a small version of Destruction Mode and follows the same rules. It has 3 objects to destruct for each team, and its maximum number of participants is 10v10.
[*]Cream Cake 10v10 is available to play only during WINTER EVENT 2019.
[*][Note] Destruction 10v10 Mode and CREAM CAKE map are only accessible at the Quick Match Channel.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28770675/dd85aec4f0e696b4d13d0fb9cacb1001bd39c5e0.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28770675/6ed8c08293e8a7e82bb045e95f1ff76f799133ed.png[/img][/list]

[list][*]Complete the mission and win the rewards: 200 WINTER POINTS & HOLIDAY TREE EVENT BOX.

[b][Changes for SEASON 4][/b]
[list][*]The division of Competitive Match Solo/Duo and Squad are unified into one Competitive Match.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28770675/0c42cb4e5200dda9ba1cf375d3fe2ad3704f1e4c.png[/img]

[*]Competitive Match Unification – Teaming
[list][*]Competitive Match teams contain 1 to 5 members.
[*][Note] Competitive Match Season 4 is the first season which unifies Solo/Duo and Squad matches, and players will have 800 MMR points to start rank placement.
[*][Note] The history of Competitive Match Season 4 will be recorded as one unified summary at your Profile details.
[*][Note] If the MMR POINT difference between the lowest team member and the highest team member is bigger than 1,000 points, the match cannot start.
[*][Note] If a user is in the match room and BANNED from competitive matches due to leave penalties, the match cannot start.[/list]
[*]Competitive Match – Matchmaking
[list][*]The unified competitive matches use the same opponent search conditions as before to match players of similar MMR points. 
[*]To search for Group Matches, matchmaking will prioritize finding groups of the same conditions. 
[list][*]e.g. A team of 4 Grouped players and 1 Solo player will have a higher chance to be matched to an opponent team consisting of 4 Grouped players and 1 Solo player.[/list]
[*]After a certain amount of time, the search range will expand to find a group of broader conditions.
[list][*]e.g. If the search for the team of 4 Grouped players and 1 Solo player is not successful during the designated time, search conditions are widened to find a team of 3~5 Grouped players.[/list]
[*]Matchmaking is improved with more subtle condition checks, there is gradual search expansion for teams that have a similar number of grouped players who is also finding a match.[/list]
[*]Season 4 initial MMR Point is 800, not affected by the Season 3 result.

[*]Unified Competitive Matches can be accessed at the lobby via one icon.

notes.title: Mute Function Update
notes.notes:
Attention Soldiers!

Starting tomorrow, August 13 we will begin to mute players when receiving Insult Reports. With our newest chat mute function, any toxic player will be muted in-game and unable to chat in public. They will still be able to play without any restrictions. 

However, severe insults may still be punished by temporary and permanent bans. Discrimination, Racism, Sexism will not be tolerated, excessive behavior will result in a permanent ban of your account.

Play fair, have fun!

-Black Squad Medics.

notes.title: BSCR Update: Official Rules
notes.notes:
Attention Soldiers!

These are the Official Rules for the upcoming Black Squad Community Cup Ranks (BSCR). Please make sure to thoroughly read the details here: http://www.blacksquad.com/bscr-rules/

During the season, players can create teams and compete in Community Cups to earn BSCP – (Black Squad Community Points) these Points are tracked on a Leaderboard to determine team ranks. The more Points a Team accumulates, the higher on the Global Rank Leaderboard it will be. The top 10 Teams will be awarded after the end of the Season.

[h1]How to Enter Community Cups:[/h1]
 
Players can find information regarding each Event and the Community Cup Schedules at https://blacksquad.com. The information may also be publicized at various official channels of Black Squad. So make sure to join us on [url=https://discordapp.com/invite/blacksquad]Discord[/url] and [url=https://www.facebook.com/playblacksquad]Facebook[/url]!
Current Official Community Cup Organizations are as follows: ASGL, CGO, ESHUB, KATT, MARCOS, EGC, and LSC. They will also provide information regarding schedule on their official media.

[h1]How to Register to BSCR:[/h1]

[b]Team Rules[/b]
[list]
[*]A Team consists of up to 6 Players.

[*][b]A Team has to appoint a Team Leader who must register their team and members for BSCR before they can start collecting points for events. [u]Teams that are not officially registered will be unable to play in Community Cups. Make sure to register for BSCR before playing in Cups.[/u][/b] 

[*]A Team cannot change or trade its members during a season, teams which change or trade any members during the season will be disqualified from the BSCR. [u]Make sure when signing up for Community Cup Events, that you sign up with the same Team Name and Team members.[/u] Information is cross-checked. Do not change Player IGN during this time or you will risk disqualification. 

[*]A Player shall belong to the region where an event is organized.

[*]A Player can only belong to one team during the BSCR.
[/list]

[H1]Team Registration[/H1]

All Team members must sign up and register at https://partner.neobricks.com/ as a Pro Gamer. These are open registrations and new teams can continually sign up!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28770675/1c0467e47d3e39f21b2f6953a269067c3b0bff41.png[/img]

[b]Team Leaders must fill out the following:[/b]

IGN:
Event Name: 'BSCR'
Role: Team Leader
Team Name: 
Server Region:

[b]Participating Team members must fill out:[/b]

IGN:
Event Name: 'BSCR'
Role: Team Member
Team Name:
Server Region:

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28770675/d9d02eecc7acc24ac56bd85861afcf7aab901c64.png[/img]

[b]Competition Format:[/b]
[list]
[*]Mode: 5v5 Demolition
[*]Number of Rounds: Minimum Best of 3, or more, depending on the Community Cup organizer.
[*]Anti-Cheat: MOSS Anti-Cheat must be used for each game by each player. If a Community Cup decides on a different Anti-Cheat to use, an event follows the decision.
[*]Other conditions of competition format (e.g. round time, switching side, brackets, etc) will follow the decision of the Community Cup Organizer for each event.
[*]A Community Cup Organizer and its Staff determine the results of the Event operated by the Community Cup Organizer. Community Cup Organizers reserve the right to make a decision regarding the operation and the challenge or appeal against the event result.
[/list]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28770675/37699a1cef8f4c90dc34bb7e2a6e6ec694e3fa6c.jpg[/img]

Global Ranking Leaderboard will be updated weekly here: http://www.blacksquad.com/bscr/

[h1]Prizes[/h1]
Prizes will be awarded and paid to the Team Leaders of the Top 10 Teams of the BSCR Leaderboard.

A total of five thousand US dollars ($5,000) in prizes will be awarded according to the following table.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28770675/8111c6b35427af22134ba678e390b3ed1efef247.jpg[/img]

[list]
[*]Tiebreakers: If two or more Teams on the Leaderboard have the same number of Points, the tie in Top 10 rank will be dealt with the same rank of them.[list]
[*]Example: If there are 3 teams ranked as 5th place with the same points. Then the following rank will stand at 8th place.[/list]
[*]The tiebreaker teams will be rewarded with the divided amount of prizes of the sum of the prizes of their ranked places by the number of tiebreaker teams.[list]
[*]Example: There are 4 teams of the same BSCP and they are followed by 8th place, the prize the 4 Teams will be rewarded, is a quarter of the amount of the sum of the 9th place prize and 10th place prize.[/list]
[*]BSCR does not grant the $ prize for each event operated by the Community Cup Organizer.
[*]BS Coin Prizes will still be distributed after every Community Cup. BS Coin Prizes have changed to the following:

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28770675/f96d4185aecef6bfe052d01ccf7d26fd68430aef.jpg[/img]
[/list]

[h1]Penalties[/h1]

A Community Cup Organizer and the Community Cup Staff determine the result of the Event operated by the Community Cup Organizer. Community Cup Organizers reserve the right to make decisions regarding the operation and the challenge or appeal against the event result. For more information please check here: http://blacksquad.com/bscr-rules/

-Black Squad Team-

notes.title: Black Squad Community Ranks Update
notes.notes:
Attention Soldiers!

Unfortunately we will have to delay the start of BSCR Season 1. At the moment we are still working on the landing pages and Team registration forms. Once the Team Registration Form is ready, you will be able to sign up for the event and start collecting BSCP! 

[H1]Team Rules[/H1]
[list]
[*]A Team consists of up to 6 Players.

[*]A Team has to appoint a Team Leader who must register their team and members for BSCR before they can start collecting points for events. [u]Teams that are not officially registered will be unable to play in Community Cups. Make sure to register for BSCR before playing in Cups if you want to make sure you receive BSCP.[/u] 

[*]A Team cannot change or trade its members during a season, teams which change or trade any members during the season will be disqualified from the BSCR. Make sure when signing up for Community Cup Events, that you sign up with the same Team Name and Team members. Information is cross-checked. Do not change Player IGN during this time or you will risk disqualification. 

[*]A Player shall belong to the region where an event is organized.

[*]Players can only belong to one team during the BSCR Season 1.
[/list]

So make sure to start planning and organizing your team so you can register! 

Sorry again for the delay.

notes.title: Black Squad Community Cup Season 1 Update!
notes.notes:
Attention Soldiers!

We proudly present to you the details of available community cups, points to attain, and rewards.

You can see the details below, we will continue to bring you information about the first season of BS Community Cup Rank, so stay tuned!

[h1]Officially Approved Community Cups[/h1]
[list]
[*]From July 28, 2019 you can earn points from the following community cup organizers and their events.

[*]Available Community Cup List: ASGL, CGO, ESHUB, KATT, MARCOS, EGC, LSC

[*]New Community Cup organizations may be added during the season, if the organization is approved and becomes official, they will be able to hold one event that will earn Rank Points.

[*]More details about how to organize a community cup can be found at our Official Discord server of Black Squad, and the application will be available at the Black Squad official homepage.

[*]One event of a Community Cup can grant points per week. If a Community Cup Organization hosts events in multiple regions, points will be granted for each region once per week.

[*]The official mode of an event is 5v5 Demolition Mode (Minimum: Best of 3). An event consisting of less than 8 teams will not grant points.

notes.title: Black Squad Official Discord Server Update
notes.notes:
Our official Discord has been remodeled so that you can access the menu with better visibility. Some menu channels have been merged together. And most importantly we have introduced direct communication between players and the Community Managers / Discord Moderators.

Direct Communication can now be done through our new Discord Bot, Modmail, which enables you to communicate and/or report directly to the staff. All you have to do is direct message (DM) the bot and this will automatically create a Support Ticket for you with a designated ticket number. Black Squad Medics and Moderators will then answer each of your tickets as quickly as possible, to the best of our abilities. You can check the Discord #help channel for further instruction. 

The Discord ban process has become clearer in Discord. And we have added universal FAQ for each supported language across Discord, Steam Discussions, and the Support Center. 

We are also planning to provide the community cup summary as a calendar, so that players who want to join a community cup can see when and where they will occur.

Visit Black Squad's Official Discord and meet players from all around the world!

Join Black Squad Discord here:

https://discordapp.com/invite/blacksquad


-The Black Squad Team

notes.title: EA Update 43: PATCH NOTE
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28770675/d2f27e5b9752510e24ea5eb40366403695a2787b.jpg[/img]


[h1][b][u][i]Matchmaking System based on User Environment[/i][/u][/b][/h1]

This update introduces a matchmaking system based on user environment, it automatically collects users who have the suitable conditions and will match them them in the most optimal server region.

This system has also been improved to not match players with high ping users who are too different. However, if queues are too long your search range will be extended for faster matchmaking. This might mean you are placed in a different server and may therefore experience higher ping.

In addition, as part of improving the matchmaking environment, new server regions have been added. More may be added or adjusted to provide better service in the future. 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28770675/2584f4e4b1bf46ace2d8ee9a8d5463b5215d6e55.png[/img]
[list][*][b]This update removes the function to select a server region for matchmaking improvement in QUICK MATCH and COMPETITIVE MATCH. Now it will automatically play the game in the best server region based on your connection area.[/b]
[list][*]However, it may match soldiers in your region as well as those in a similar region environment. This will provide a faster matchmaking environment.
[*]Thus, the relevant UI has been redesigned for this.[/list]

[*]The Server Region Lists are removed from the Launcher.
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28770675/cf8d543201c16cef0520bcd98eee903297eb724e.png[/img]

[*]Shortcut Function
[list][*]Important improvements in this update include the function to add shortcuts to the main lobby so that you can participate more quickly and conveniently in QUICK MATCH and COMPETITIVE MATCH.
[*]If you click the button corresponding to each game mode, you can ignore the intermediate process and proceed directly to room creation, then you can search for the game immediately.
[*][b][Note][/b] If you leave the match room, you will be moved to each Channel lobby, not the main lobby.[/list]

[*]QUICK MATCH and COMPETITIVE MATCH CHANNEL
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28770675/d944d9c4e9b75bc0b98f5296aa113bdc2da02e1d.png[/img]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28770675/832889c1d9210334c8ecdd6d5f5e0d767edbe047.png[/img]

[list][*]In QUICK MATCH and COMPETITIVE MATCH CHANNEL, if the physical distance between players is too big, the game cannot be started.
[*]If a game is not found in QUICK MATCH and COMPETITIVE MATCH CHANNEL in the best server region, the search range will be expanded so that it searches your region as well as similar server regions.[/list]

[*]CUSTOM MATCH and CLAN MATCH CHANNEL
[i](CUSTOM MATCH CHANNEL)[/i]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28770675/61e2d0ecac9bfe81eb17fe16dc6b425ab80e095f.png[/img]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28770675/ec150f33b7a7e123f2d5744458a91806579a09c0.png[/img]
[i](CLAN MATCH CHANNEL)[/i]

[list][*]When you create a match room in CUSTOM or CLAN CHANNEL, the server region is determined based on the location of the match room host.
[*][b][Note][/b] The server region of the match room is not changed even if the host changes to another server region.[/list][/list]


[h1][b][u][i]NEW QUICK MATCH[/i][/u][/b][/h1]
[list][*][EVENT] Battlecage 8v8 Mode added to QUICK MATCH CHANNEL.

notes.title: Black Squad Steam Market and Trade Policy Update
notes.notes:
Hello Soldiers,

On March 13 we will  update the trade/market policies on Black Squad items via Steam Community Market.

[code]Items: Items obtainable in-game or from DLC 
- Unable to trade or sell via Steam market

Items: Items not obtainable in-game or from DLC
-  Marketable (sellable) via Steam market, not tradable [/code]
 
Example: According to the updated policy, Item A which is currently obtainable in-game is not tradable or sellable in Steam Market. However, once Item A is retired and no longer available in the in-game Shop, Item A will be available to sell or buy (not trade) in the Steam Market.

Please note that all items currently on sale in the Steam Market will follow the above rules after the policy change. 

[b]So please be aware that the change will be applied from March 13 alongside the patch update.[/b] Therefore, any items not already in the Steam Market will not change to be included in the future. We appreciate your understanding.

-Black Squad Team

notes.title: How to fix Error 0xc00007b & Errors with the 64-Bit version
notes.notes:
Hello Soldiers,

We recognized that some players have issues with playing Black Squad since the latest Hotfix where we introduced the 64-bit version of the game.

We apologize for any inconveniences caused and want to share some fixes that work for most of players.

[h1]ERROR 0xc00007b APPLICATION WAS UNABLE TO START CORRECTLY[/h1]
You can find detailed instructions on how to fix this error in our FAQ section here: http://support.blacksquad.com/kb/faq.php?id=66
[b]Note[/b]: Method 6 fixed the issue for most of them.

[h1]ERRORS WITH 64-BIT VERSION[/h1]
If you get any other error-messages with using the 64-bit Version or you feel like the 64-bit Version is not running smoothly for you, you can still manually start the 32-bit Version of the game.

This can be found in your Black Squad directory in the Steam folder.
[b]For example:[/b] " ...\steamapps\common\Black Squad\binaries\win32\"

You need to doubleclick "[b]SteamLauncher.exe[/b]" and you should be able to play the game again.

If you experience any other issues, please feel free to contact us through support at http://support.blacksquad.com

- The Black Squad Team

A new system has been added, which automatically reduces the MMR POINT(s) for soldiers who don’t participate in Competitive Solo/Duo or SQUAD for a long time.
[list]
[*][b]The operation policy and rules are as below.[/b]
[list]
[*] If you do not participate in the Competitive Match for 72 hours, the system will operate and reduce the MMR POINT(s) immediately.
[*] MMR POINT(s) will be reduced every 24 hours thereafter.
[*]The MMR POINT(s) will be reduced as shown below:
[list]
[*]Soldier with more than 1,551 points: 30 points reduction
[*]Soldier with more than 1,151 points: 15 points reduction
[*]Soldier with less than 1,150 points: Not applicable to the system.
[/list]
[*] This system does not reduce the MMR POINT(s) below 1,150 points.
[*] The system works separately for SOLO/DUO and SQUAD.
[/list]

[*]If you leave the match even during the map loading or waiting for network synchronization before the match starts, you will get the leaving penalty. If you do not want to get the penalty, you must return to the match and complete the match normally.

[*] For soldiers who leave the match frequently, the ban duration penalty in Competitive Match will be higher.

[*] At the end of Competitive Match Season 1, the rewards will be given out based on the final MMR POINT(s). Therefore, it is recommended for soldiers to play as regular as possible, since this system may reduce the final MMR POINT at the end of Season 1.

A new test server is added to check the connectivity in North America – West.
[list]

[h1]COMPETITIVE MODE VOICE CHAT[/h1]

VOICE CHAT is now available to use in Competitive Match.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28770675/2b7bb4b5c74df1fbbe98675af3d8e3a05658cbed.png[/img]
[list]
[*]In order to use VOICE CHAT, please go to 'SETTINGS - SOUND - Voice Channel - Connect/Disconnect'.
[*]The default settings of ‘Voice Channel’ is OFF.
[*]The setting will save from the last change.
[/list]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28770675/1c051955ae1711fc3ea929a6acfb4c646e5da4f2.png[/img]

There are two ways of using VOICE CHAT.
[list]
[*]ALL THE TIME: (Always On)
[*]PUSH TO TALK: The shortcut key is the 'O' key.
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28770675/18c815e174446a646aae41c50638c31fd233d56f.png[/img]
[/list]

You can adjust the volume level as shown below.
[list]
[*]INPUT VOLUME (Speaking Voice- MIC): 1 - 20
[*]OUTPUT VOLUME (Listening to Voice - Speaker): 1 - 20
[/list]

If you join the competitive match with the feature turned on, the VOICE CHAT function will automatically activate.
[list]
[*]VOICE CHAT is only possible between team members.
[*]Competitive Match - You can adjust the option of MIC & Speaker for you and your team members.
[*]For you - Check(ON/OFF) or Adjust 'Output Volume' in Sound Settings
[*]For team members - Check(ON/OFF) or Adjust 'Input Volume' in Sound Settings
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28770675/3c4636fe37c8fcae585879b8682071c36448cbe1.png[/img]
[/list]

To see who is using VOICE CHAT during the match, the callsign of whom is using VOICE CHAT will display below the top left mini map. It will not display when the soldier does not use VOICE CHAT.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28770675/5f50ecfd2b51d28b47554eca09c09516ca379cfe.png[/img]

When the match ends and you move to the lobby, the VOICE CHAT automatically ends.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28770675/6506e9a8b95d7c6ebc5b116c1853c46e35a707ba.png[/img]
[list]
[*]The Surrender Vote Function allows the team to accept to give up the match prior to playing, when it is determined that the team will ‘Lose’.
[*]In order to activate, press ESC and Click on the Surrender Vote UI button, or type '/FF' in Chat Window.
-The Surrender Voting starter is treated as "ACCEPT".
[*]When Voting starts, a system message is displayed on the Chat Window, informing that the Voting has started, and the Surrender UI is displayed on the bottom right of the HUD.
-The system message is displayed only to the team as below format.
-“*** started a Surrender Vote. Surrender is possible only if all soldiers accept. If one soldier rejects, Surrender Vote will be void.”'
[*]Surrender Voting can be done by using the following shortcuts.
-F7 - ACCEPT, F8 - REJECT
-[Note] The 'Friendly IFF ON / OFF' function which was previously assigned to the F8 key has been changed to the '” shortcut key.
[*]The Surrender Vote time is 30 seconds in total, and if the vote is rejected, you can try again 3 minutes later.
-If rejected, the system message “Surrender Vote is over. The match will proceed again according to the result of the voting.”, is displayed in the Chat Window.
-If you start a Surrender Vote again within 3 minutes, the system message “you will not be able to vote again immediately if a Surrender Vote is in progress or it is rejected. Please wait for a while", is displayed in the Chat Window.
-If you do not vote, 'REJECT' will be automatically selected, when voting is ended 30 seconds later.
-If you leave the match during the Surrender Voting, "ACCEPT" is automatically selected.
[*]When the Surrender Vote is activated, soldiers who were not in the match cannot vote.
-Those soldiers are displayed as blank in UI, and the remaining team soldiers are regarded as the maximum voting number.
[*]If a Surrender Vote is done as all agreed, the team will 'Lose'.
[*]If a Surrender Vote has already been activated, another Surrender Vote cannot be activated.
[/list]

[b][VICTORY CONDITIONS FOR GAME][/b]
[list]
[*]Protect your target from AI attacks and break through the final wave for VICTORY.
[*]You can use your skills through points earned by killing AI.

[/list]

notes.title: EA Update 24: Patch Notes
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28770675/5fc2c2fdf143d63d6630a03b9776e295868363cb.jpg[/img]

[h1][b]System, Content[/b][/h1]

[u]Crouch spam prevention system application[/u]
[list]
[*]The crouch spam prevention system has been applied to all servers/channels.
[*]What is the crouch spam prevention system?
[list][*]When you crouch continuously several times in a row continuously, crouching speed becomes slower. This system prevents users from having advantages from crouching continuously during combat. When crouching is not used continuously, crouching and standing can be used at normal speed.[/list]
[*]Crouch spam prevention system functions. 
[list][*]Stamina has been added. Crouching requires stamina.
[*]Stamina is not displayed on HUD.
[*]Stamina decreases per crouch.
[*]When crouch is used several times, stamina will decrease. The speed of crouching is direct related with the amount of stamina.
[*]Crouch is available with 100% speed when you have enough stamina.
[*]When there is not enough stamina, the crouching speed will be very slow.[/list][/list]
-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Hello from the Black Squad development team. 

We tested the crouch spam prevention system on the test channel and we received many types of feedbacks from you.
We analyzed the opinions of the players regarding the improvement of some functions and finally applied them as follows. 
The following changes have been made to the crouch spam prevention system that was applied to the test channel.
[list][*]The stamina recovery speed has been increased. The time required to recover to its maximum has been decreased.
[*]Now you can crouch even if you do not have the minimum stamina required. However the crouch is executed at its slowest speed.
[*]Before, when stamina reached 0, stamina did not start to recover immediately. Now when the stamina reaches 0, the recovery happens immediately. As a result, the time to reach maximum stamina (100) has been decreased. 
[*]Even if you crouch continuously, you can crouch for the first and second time without any speed changes. From the third time on, the user will experience slowness in crouching.[/list]
Thank you all for your participation in the last test.
-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

[u]Battle Record Check After Death[/u]
[list]
[*]Checking each round’s battle record after your character’s death is now available in Demolition and Assassination mode.
[*]Damage you have received, damage to enemies, and kill record is now available.
[*]Battle record will be reset after your character’s death or at the end of the round.
[*]Display battle record when the round ends, in case you are still alive.
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28770675/d3729f4190396fd2938bb5859bd622d0fdc0404d.png[/img][/list]

[h1][b]Function Improvements[/b][/h1]
[list][*]Regardless of right or left hand mode setting, the skills and weapons below will be displayed with right hand mode only.
[list][*]C4
[*]All the skills except M32, XM25, AT4, STEYR50.
[list][*]Claymore, Ammo kit, Medi kit, UAV, Sonar Vision, Hell Pike, Sentry Gun, Trophy System, Juggernaut, Artillery support, Heli Support, Air Strike.[/list][/list]
[*]The duration for kick AFK(Away from keyboard) has become shorter.
[list][*]Match room: 5Min → 3Min
[*]In game: 2Min → 1.5Min[/list][/list]

[h1][b]Bug Fix[/b][/h1]
[list][*]Fixed crosshair alpha value.
[*]Fixed invisible weapon display bug that occurs when swapping weapons while throwing grenade.
[*]Fixed overlap display bug for some Turkish	.
[*]Fixed tool tip display bug for upper, down side icon in lobby.
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28770675/7e3ac08b83cdec3067380aef15cb087ab6e5cfda.jpg[/img][/list]

notes.title: EA Patch Note 19
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28770675/0d7aaaee90245eba81171c97ac9ac5e6158faf00.jpg[/img]

[h1][b]System & Content[/b][/h1]

[u]Added test channel[/u]

Hello from the Black squad development team.

This patch adds a test channel, and the configuration of the test channel is shown below.
[list]
[*]Only players who have the test channel ticket can enter the test channel.
[*]The test channel has a crouch spam prevention system.
[*]The mode/map configuration of the test channel is the same as the custom channel. [/list]
The development team has been monitoring the use of Crouch spam and has come to the conclusion that they should be restricted in continuous use.

The Crouch Spam Prevention System is shown below:
[list]
[*]A stamina system has been added, and this stamina is a necessary resource for crouching.
[*]Stamina will be deducted once per crouching.
[*]If the remaining stamina is gradually reduced by using the crouching several times, the crouching/standing speed becomes slower in proportion to the current stamina amount.
[*]If the stamina is at its maximum, the crouching/standing will happen at 100% speed.
[*]If the remaining stamina is insufficient, the speed of crouching/standing will be very slow.
[*]If you do not have enough stamina to do one crouch, you will not be able to crouch. You will need to restore your stamina to a certain amount of time before you can crouch again.
[*]When the stamina reaches zero, it takes about 6 seconds to recover to its maximum value.[/list]
Because of the Crouch Spam Prevention System, there is now a limit to the use of Crouching when engaging the enemy, and if used continuously, the Stamina will be depleted quickly and you will not be able to use Crouching until the Stamina is restored. This helps to prevent the Crouch spam.

We hope that the system will have a positive effect. The new system will be applied only to the test channel without applying it to all servers from the beginning. We will receive various opinions from the testers and improve the application timing and system completeness.

The tester selection and the operation plans for the test channel will be announced soon.
We look forward in having a great amount of participation in the test activities, and many feedbacks from players.

Thank you.

[u]Crouch Spam prevention added in practice mode[/u]
[list][*]For test purposes, crouch spam prevention has been added to practice mode.[/list]
[u]Lunar New Year Special sale ended[/u]
[list][*]Lunar New Year Special sale has ended.[/list]
[u]Korean language support[/u]
[list][*]You can choose Korean language above on the game launcher.[/list]
[u]Improvement in Clan Match-Making[/u]

Those users whose rank points are too high or low were having trouble in clan match-making,
So we changed the matching system to search for a more wide range of users with faster speed 
[list][*]Marginal lowest rank points changed from 2500 to 2800
- Rank points lower than 2800 will be changed to 2800.[/list]

[h1][b]Medal Shop[/b][/h1]
[list][*]SIZ556XI RUS GL is now on sale.
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28770675/fc8f7b7cce01f9f8f38ac6c0c91a30faec13197a.png[/img][/list]

[h1][b]Function Improvements[/b][/h1]
[list][*]Spawn protection will be removed as soon as the protected player do a hostile act. For example, throwing a grenade, attack with a knife or a gun, or using a skill.  
[*]Added weapon FOV option
- Choose FOV value from -5.0 to +5.0. Default FOV is 0.
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28770675/5f186f4943aa6c9cf66ab0fdbfb14bed0a30dce3.png[/img]
[*]Improved Lobby, In-game chatting display.
- Words in chatting box will no longer be truncated from now on. 
[*]Improved discern system of the tile that the character is stepping on. Now is possible to identify more accurately the character location with the step sound effect. [/list]

[h1][b]Bug[/b][/h1]
[list][*]Fixed abnormal grenade display bug in spectator mode.
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28770675/5e883b4f2d2a4b414c6dbfb6f8501fdc5df6a614.png[/img]
[*]Fixed a bug in game launcher - While in server maintenance, the MAINTENANCE button on launcher will no longer be changed to PLAY button. 
[*]Fixed defuse bug in DUSTSHIELD B site, defusing bomb in B site functions normally now. C4 plant area become little smaller, therefore from now on planting the bomb in the pit is impossible.
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28770675/2926bcf96e7daac75c1a13ef4678f0b8d2e1036c.jpg[/img][/list]

[h1][b]System & Content[/b][/h1]

[u]Spectator camera first/third person view toggle option for host[/u]
[list]
[*]Added spectator camera first/third person view toggle option in Demolition, Assassination Mode as host option.
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28770675/a8474efe0f23f020f88462ee9d8577f28f64fa62.png[/img]
[*]Default value is “off”.
[*]Host can decide On/Off.  In the case that spectator camera option is “ON”, after death, you can observe teammates. You can toggle view to first person or third person by spacebar.
[*]Only available in custom channel.
[/list]

[u]Real time ping check[/u] 
[list]
[*]You can check server’s real time ping that you selected in server/channel lobby.
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28770675/dbb0d4fc72674b93c6aca56d0310c9e30f647252.png[/img]
[*]You can see server’s real time ping that you are joining from the bar that is located upper right corner of the screen.
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28770675/8d27d868465878973d1a928ca1200cd8abf40fa8.png[/img]
[/list]

[u]Improved clan information UX[/u]
[list]
[*]You can see clan information by clicking clan name section in the user’s profile.
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28770675/8d35884857c043ab56210defed446ebfce9a18c2.png[/img]
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28770675/7fbc476502ec6009410f72053c9a9fdd061be013.png[/img]
[*]In clan list, default arrangement of list is “sort by clan rank point”.
[*]Increased the number of matches displayed in clan's Recent Records from 5 to 20. 
[/list]

[h1][b]New Items[/b][/h1]

[u]Shop[/u]
[list]
[*]Battle History Reset Ticket is available now.
- Price: 1,200 Bullet / Permanent.
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28770675/30e2c857ce40c6cc51ded96e5cea39ce96cb7271.png[/img]
- Battle History Reset Ticket reset the following stats.
- Please be aware that your previous battle history CANNOT be restored after using Battle History Reset Ticket.
*Total  win / lose
*Total  kill / assist / death
*Classic  win / lose
*Classic  kill / assist / death
*Clan  win / lose
*Clan  kill / assist / death
*Number of head shots, fatal shots
[/list]

[h1][b]Function Improvements[/b][/h1]
[list]
[*]Now you can distinguish between friendly and enemy players while using spectator mode. You can toggle ON/OFF by F8
[*]Yes/no pop-up window will appear for final check when you use call sign change ticket.
[*]Feedback message will appear when your call sign that you want is not available.
- Someone has already using the call sign. 
- Contains unavailable character.
- Contains restricted word.
[*]From now on, personal rank points will remain even if you leave the clan.
[*]If you are not currently in the clan, your personal rank points will be deactivated. It will be displayed as “ - ”. It will activate after joining a clan.
After join a clan, personal rank points will be displayed normally.
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28770675/e64bc7ae8a729c0ad32efe60a7d46b090abb971b.png[/img] 
[/list]

[h1][b]Bug[/b][/h1]
[list]
[*]The name card “Happy New Year By .Phz”, its name has corrected.
[/list]

[h1][b]SYSTEM, CONTENT[/b][/h1]

[u]Rank Point Reset & Start of Pre-season[/u]
[list]
[*]This update will reset your clan and individual rank points, and the trial season for Clan Ranked Match will end
[*]Following Calling Card prizes will be given based on rank points achieved during the trial season
[olist]
[*]Grand Prize – Rank point above or equal to 3,400
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28770675/59d363e3d178647d1f50bd64c52852da1d209829.png[/img]
[*]Excellence Prize – Rank point above or equal to 3,100 ~ below 3,400
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28770675/ba9c357cff1be4329c4c3572ce036c486149c2e5.png[/img]
[*]Participation Prize – Rank point below 3,100
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28770675/eb1ab1b39781e53fad9aa488b1030c86684674c8.png[/img]
[/olist]
[*]The Clan Ranked Match Pre-season will start
 - Your initial individual rank points for the pre-season will depend on your rank points achieved during the trial season
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28770675/5865d3f9d9d276e2dc212b7bcc057a01bc0e0d67.png[/img]
[*]Improved the clan matchmaking logic
[olist]
[*]You will be no longer matched against the previous team (except in the case of matchmaking failure for a long time due to shortage of matching opponents)
[*]Search time is reduced, and search range is extended more precisely based on the team’s average points
[*]A match between two teams with huge difference in rank points is prevented
[*]The minimum value of the individual rank points is reduced from 2,800 points to 2,500 points
[*]Clan rank points earned or lost by winning or losing the match will be reduced
[*]Your relative rank points (either even or advantage) will be more precisely calculated
[/olist]
[*]Clan Creation level decreased from staff sergeant rank 2 to sergeant
[/list]

[u]Free DLC – Welcome Fortune Box[/u]
[list]
[*]As appreciation, ‘Free DLC – Welcome Fortune Box’ will be available for everyone
[*]You will receive one permanent item at random
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28770675/faa9c47bbb41d065cfc312d0cf4c638683be8527.png[/img]
[/list]

[olist]

[/olist]
[/list]

[*]Recommended to use English for the time being improvement of each languages.
[/list]
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28770675/c324d6f4df8388d2395362468a7a5b98daaa2c2b.png[/img]
[u][Halloween Event][/u]
[list]
[*]Added Halloween-themed content and items
[*]Every Halloween-themed content and items will be valid until November 8 (or next update)
[*]Halloween Sale (All items are 20% off) excluding random Shop items (new random shop items will have 10% off)
M4 Custom GL Dragon Blue
M4 Custom GL Dragon Red
M4 Custom GL AOR1
M4 Custom GL MTP
Cavaliere Rhino Chrome
Cheryl
Cheryl B
AK47 Halloween
Blazer R93 Halloween
Desert Eagle Halloween
Nimravus Halloween
Halloween Card
[/list]

[u]PVE Channel for AI Defense Mode[/u]
[list]
[*]Maximum of 4 players are required to save the target from AI attack and needs to clear 12 waves in 30 minutes
[*]Skills can be used by points earned from killing AI
[*]3 lives are provided in each wave and when they are all spent, you cannot be respawned
[*]If friendly force clears the wave after your death, you will respawn in next wave
[*]If all your friendly forces die, mission is counted as failed
[*]You can either choose Easy or Normal mode
[*]The mission can only be played in its own map, Tempest

notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28770675/861e2e7c5439bbeda06295ec0536452bc21479fa.jpg[/img]

[h1][b]SYSTEM, CONTENT[/b][/h1]
[u][Clan Ranked Match][/u]

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28770675/48a8dfac75be263329eb688778d934343c639fc8.png[/img]
[list]
[*]Newly added Clan Ranked Match is still a beta version, and can be run temporarily to verify various systems and content to be added in the future
[*]Rank point increase and decreases depending on the match results
[*]Range of increase and decrease of point will be judged as relative superiority, equality, and relative disadvantage depending on clan’s current rank point
[*]Clan Ranked Match is only playable for premade 5-players team with at leat 3 or more players of the same clan
[*]Default ranked point is as below
 - Player: 3,000 point
 - Clan: 15,000 point
 - Player rank point won’t drop below 2,800 points
[*]Due to the addition of Clan Ranked Match, the existing clan match will be removed
[/list]
[Clan Home]
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28770675/992f23d7af0de98b7b8adfe876057da3e1512e3a.png[/img]
[View Details]
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28770675/3221c1d152b6d043bc0bc711d5ea4c02d4af7fc3.png[/img]

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28770675/201996ef6a86bdbe3d37d415c06fdb472ccd3b5c.png[/img]

[u][Clan Daily Mission][/u]

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28770675/1317070220a75912528bdcdb536586241bc0156a.png[/img]
[list]
[*]The addition of Clan Ranked Match will change the contents of the Clan Daily Mission

[/list]

[h1][b]ITEMS & WEAPONS[/b][/h1]
[u][Medal Shop][/u]

[list]
[*]M107A1 = 3,200 Medal
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28770675/c6212dae9e6b725d226ee764180ec7ced72ac810.png[/img]
[*]M107A1 Snake = 20,000 BS Coin
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28770675/0c393c2eefe04d8280c95bee7c7fabbe52e98ec7.png[/img]
[*]M107A1 AOR1 = 500 BS Coin
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28770675/499d1c9de801107dcab51b9fd093a62d741b08f4.png[/img]
[*]M107A1 MTP = 500 BS Coin
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28770675/3cd3f43abce0dc3309d0f2754a2f8f41d6e6f859.png[/img]
[*]AK12 Western = 20,000 BS Coin
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28770675/2d35f4649b143c5b561838748ad6bb4e41b3e59f.png[/img]
[/list]

[u]Random Box Shop][/u]
[list]
[*]AK12 Western Box
[*]M107A1 Box
[/list]
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28770675/1ea722d063c1c0f4bf03aae1eecfef404817561e.png[/img]

[h1][b]BALANCE[/b][/h1]
[list]
[*]Weapon
 - All SMG’s range has decreased
 - MP7
: Damage to the chest of the character has been adjusted from 24 to 22
: Damage to the body of the character has been adjusted from 20 to 19
 - SIZMPX
: Damage to the chest of the character has been adjusted from 26 to 25
[*] Destruction/Capture Mode
 - Damage factor for all LMG to enemy supplies has been adjusted from 60% to 40% 
 - Juggernaut
: Skill activation level(in-game) has been lowered from Colonel to Major
: Cooldown has been adjusted from 90 to 60 seconds
[/list]

[h1][b]SYSTEM IMPROVEMENT[/b][/h1]
[list]
[*]Changes related to High Ping restriction under test
 - Changed the max ping limit value from 200 to 220
 - Added ping limit to Europe Clan Match Channel for the version
[*]In the attendance check, the confirmation of the medals awarded on the 7th, 14th, 21st and 28th is not intuitive, so the representative image has been changed from gold to medal
[/list]
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28770675/3425d25d96041dd2e2beee6678dbee4106d7eee8.png[/img]

[h1][b]BUG FIX[/b][/h1]
[list]
[*]Fixed a bug of shortcut keys of “Enter” and “ESC” not working properly on some of other pop-up menus

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28770675/c50264c2fe7ea130c3239aa045c2679f1f23343c.jpg[/img]

Let's keep on improving Black Squad!

notes.title: EA PATCH NOTE 6
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28770675/0cf12a56982d3d6b63e75b1b91f8a4379220aad8.jpg[/img]

[h1][b]System, Content[/b][/h1]
 
[u][Zoom Sensitivity Option][/u]
- Players will now be able to adjust zoom sensitivity of each pre-set
- Mouse sensitivity and each of pre-set’s zoom sensitivity can be adjustable in 
  “Option-> Control -> Mouse settings”
  * Default setting is 5.0
  * If you check “ALL” then it will act as a master sensitivity and be applied to all three pre-set’s
  * You can control the sensitivity by pressing [ and ] button 

(upon testing, we found a bug in zoom sensitivity which you can set your sensitivity 10 as a maximum sensiivity. This bug will be fixed on next week's patch)

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28770675/df27e6a74382b058659adac69efef8ccc8404573.png[/img]

[u][Server/Channel UI][/u]
- Fixed a traffic bar bug (Which the green bar didn’t increase on Quick Match Channel)
- Star icon is added in front of the channel which gives exp/gold boost
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28770675/73e9a30fb11773fb85cb5ecf0ed8766f4ea6904a.png[/img]

[u][Quick Match Logic][/u]
- Improved the quick match quality
- Quick match balance divided into two levels; 
   * Enlisted level only 
   * Officer level only
- Officer level is also divided into two levels;
   * Officer rank with below 1.2 KAD
   * Officer rank with and above 1.2 KAD
 
[u][BOT TDM PASSWORD SETTING][/u]
- Players can now set a password when creating a BOT TDM room in a Custom Math Channel

[u]System[/u]
- Reduced the siren sound of Assassination mode
- Ping Check time in EU Quick Match increased from 10 seconds to 20 seconds
 
[h1][b]MODE/MAP[/b][/h1]
- TDM (Quick Match/Custom Match): Harbor Noon
 
[h1][b]ITEMS & WEAPONS[/b][/h1]
 
[u][Medal Shop][/u]
- M45 CQBP Chrome has better animation compared to M45 QBP
[list]
[*]M45 CQBP
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28770675/04a0f1e583ec04470fbb035b4b0bdbac897eca32.png[/img]
[*]M45 CQBP Chrome
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28770675/24eeecab405fc7cd8cb9c3537a489e26ea935bc8.png[/img]
[/list]

[u][Random Box][/u]
[list]

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28770675/bdeba20bc47645b2173b9591f2d8b4a772f0f760.png[/img]
[/list]

[u][Country Flag][/u]
[list]
[*]Colombia
[*]Denmark
[*]Finland
[*]Hong Kong
[*]Israel
[*]Malaysia
[*]Philippines
[*]Romania

[h1][b]BALANCE[/b][/h1]

[*]MK14: Recoil and Crosshair changed the same as Kor Ver.
[*]G36: Increased the rate of fire (buffed)
[*]SIZMPX: decreased the rate of fire (nerfed) / Reduced the damage from 25 to 24
